payout_value_note: $25-$200 across 4 independently achievable public legs ($100+$50+$25+$25); advertised $275 includes employer-gated $75 leg
payout_quote: Earn up to $275 when you open an AIM Checking account. Earn $100 - Direct Deposit Bonus: When at least 3 direct deposits totaling a minimum of $12,000 credit to this account within the qualifying bonus period. Earn $50 - Auto Transfer Bonus: Complete at least 3 recurring automatic transfers from this account to a TBK Bank savings or money market account within the qualifying bonus period. Earn $25 - Bill Pay Bonus: When 9 Bill Pay transactions to service providers clear/debit this account within the qualifying bonus period. Earn $25 - Point-Of-Sale Bonus: When 50 one time or recurring Point-of-Sale (POS) transactions clear/debit this account within the qualifying bonus period. Earn $75 - TBK at Work Bonus: When you indicate that you are a TBK at Work Participant and provide a TBK Bank referral code during the qualifying bonus period.
steps: Open a new AIM Checking account online or in person ($100 minimum opening deposit; 18+, application approval).
Within 120 calendar days of account opening: (a) have 3+ direct deposits totaling $12,000+ for $100.
(b) complete 3+ recurring auto-transfers from AIM to a TBK savings/MM account for $50.
(c) make 9+ Bill Pay transactions to service providers for $25.
(d) make 50+ POS debit transactions (ATM withdrawals excluded) for $25.
Keep the account open and active; bonuses credit the next business day after the 120-day period.
catches: The headline '$275' includes a $75 TBK at Work leg requiring a participating-employer referral code - excluded from the public max.
The $100 Direct Deposit leg requires 3 direct deposits totaling $12,000+ within 120 days - a high bar.
Limit one of each bonus type; converted accounts are not eligible.
$100 minimum opening deposit; $24 monthly service charge unless waived (avg $5,000 available balance, $25,000 total relationship, or $4,000 total DD per cycle).
Bonuses credited next business day after the 120-day bonus period; account must be open and active.
Cash bonus payments may be reported to the IRS as interest (taxable).
Offer effective 9/27/2025 and 'subject to change at any time' - no stated expiry date.
biggest_catch: The $100 direct-deposit leg needs 3 deposits totaling $12,000+ within 120 days, and the $24 monthly service charge only waives with a $5,000 average balance, $25,000 total relationship, or $4,000/month in direct deposits - cheap to open, expensive to hold without waivers.
eligibility: New AIM Checking customers 18+; converted accounts not eligible. Subject to application approval.
timing: Bonuses credited the next business day after the 120-day qualifying period. No expiry stated.

notes: VERIFIED. TBK Bank (FDIC) AIM Checking cash-bonus program, current official terms at tbkbank.com fetched 2026-09-23. Distinct product from R5970 Everyday Checking ($175 headline) and R5978 Launch Checking ($50 headline) - separate per-leg bonus structure and higher $12,000 DD threshold for the $100 leg. Public max $200; $75 employer-gated TBK-at-Work leg excluded. No expiry stated - terminable at any time.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $25–$200. Per official terms: Bonuses credited the next business day after the 120-day qualifying period. No expiry stated. Earliest realistic: ~5 months (fixed 120-day qualification period + the payout window — finishing early does not pay sooner).
maximize: Fastest honest path. The qualification period is a fixed calendar window — finishing the required transactions early does NOT pay the bonus sooner; the bank calculates the bonus only after the period closes. Fastest honest path: complete the required transactions in the first week so you can't forget them, then wait out the period with the account open and in good standing.
